title: [GMCP 203.008.06] Operations and evidence: Complete schemas, primitives, content, and metadata model
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-008-06. Ship inspectable CLI, TUI or API state, configuration validation, bounded metrics/logs/traces, diagnostics, examples, migration and rollback guidance, incident runbooks, and reproducible evidence artifacts. Automate drift detection so a changed dependency or standard invalidates stale proof. Vector outcome: Every MCP primitive and content variant is represented losslessly, including annotations, icons, resource links and embedded resources, binary media, extensions, cache scope/TTL, audience and priority metadata, and JSON Schema 2020-12 input/output contracts. Round-trip fixtures preserve unknown extension fields; schema limits, external-reference policy, Unicode, URI and MIME validation, and canonical serialization are exhaustively tested. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
